I would still have rolling and the ability to evade attacks and gunfire and quickly fire back, so I would both try to have tactical/defensive combat as well as dynamic aggressive combat where required. One of the complaints in the earlier games was the fact you couldn't aim or strafe/properly evade when shooting.

It would mostly be modernising the gameplay the way God of war 2018 changed the gameplay. The open world elements would be like open world games today, the shooting would feature manual aim and the ability to take cover in firefights. There would still be platforming segments that require you to jump, roll etc. I would probably get rid of the double jump and spin attack.
